rawFindings.title: Removed BOM and EOL escape in File reads
rawFindings.explanation: The code previously applied escapeBOM and escapeEOL on file content when reading (in both async and sync methods) if the option 'escape' was true (default). The patch removes this feature entirely, disabling all BOM and Windows line ending normalization.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore escapeContent function and invocations in read and readSync methods, respecting the 'escape' option, to preserve existing behavior and prevent potential issues with BOM characters and inconsistent line endings.

rawFindings.title: Removal of BOM and EOL escaping from File.read() and File.readSync()
rawFindings.explanation: The patch removes the calls to escapeBOM and escapeEOL functions from File.read() and File.readSync(), which previously sanitized content by removing BOM and normalizing Windows EOLs. This changes the returned content behavior by no longer processing escape sequences on read, potentially affecting code relying on this behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the call to escapeContent(result) in File.read() and File.readSync() when options.escape is true to preserve existing content normalization behavior.

rawFindings.title: Removed BOM and EOL escaping breaks expected behavior for File.read
rawFindings.explanation: The patch removes the escapeBOM and escapeEOL imports, the escapeContent function, and disables content escaping when reading files. The removed test cases verify that BOM is stripped and Windows line endings are converted, which is a behavior that client code might depend on. Without this escaping, clients will receive raw content that includes BOM and Windows line endings, likely causing unexpected issues.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the escapeBOM and escapeEOL imports, the escapeContent function, and the logic in File.prototype.read to apply escapeContent when options.escape is true (which is default). Restore related tests to ensure correct behavior.
